text: Mandi qualcuno a ripararlo, per favore
ipa: mˈandɪ kwalkˈuno a ripaɾˈarlo, per favˈore

literal: enough, stop -- basta makes it terminal against the pausa in the row below, and the row is deliberately unsoftened where this pack's other requests carry per favore

a pause, please -- pausa says temporarily on its own, and unlike this pack's communication.please-wait-a-moment (Un momento, per favore) it asks the listener to suspend what they are doing rather than to wait for the speaker

text: Non prema su questa zona, per favore
ipa: non prˈɛma sʊ kwˌɛsta dzˈɔna, per favˈore
literal: please do not press on this area -- zona is the noun Italian massage writing uses for a region of the body (la zona inguinale, la zona dolorante, quest'area e troppo sensibile)

press harder, please -- premere keeps it about pressure rather than speed; the same source has a client saying stai pressando troppo in questa zona. Five words against the two of Piu delicato, and the per favore sits on this row only, because neither button carries a labelKey on the spa board and the owner's own wording is what labels them, side by side

more gently -- delicato is the spa's own word for low pressure (una zona che va lavorata in modo molto delicato) and, unlike piu piano, cannot be read as speed. Left bare so its shape differs from the row beside it
like this it is fine, carry on like this -- a confirmation with a keep-it-there clause, not praise; continui is the Lei imperative and carries no gender
lavorare una zona is the trade's own verb for working an area
the trade groups this with the shoulders and sells collo e spalle, or massaggio cervicale, as one service, but the two rows stay separate because a board button is one meaning

riflessologia plantare, the massaggio ai piedi Italian centri benessere sell by that name, is a bookable service of its own, so this reads as asking for one rather than for part of a full-body treatment
all right, I will avoid that area -- 1sg present indicative, which does not agree in gender, unlike a passato prossimo participle

text: Questo trattamento non si può fare senza quella zona
ipa: kwˌɛsto trattamˈento non sɪ pʊˈɔ fˈare sˌɛntsa kwˌɛlla dzˈɔna
literal: this treatment cannot be done without that area -- the impersonal si puo carries no gender; trattamento is one bookable service, not a ciclo, which would be a course of several and overstate what is being refused
does this area hurt -- Le is the formal indirect object and is invariant, as in this pack's board-answers.where-does-it-hurt

text: Non lo so, devo chiedere alla direzione
ipa: non lo sˈɔ, dˈɛvo kjˈɛdere ˌalla diretsiˈone
literal: I do not know, I have to ask the management -- la direzione is an abstract role noun, so it names the supervisor without the gendered article that il/la responsabile would force; non lo so replaces non sono sicuro/sicura, whose adjective would inflect for the speaker
